dependencyRisks.summary: One OPEN HIGH dependency vulnerability recorded for Newtonsoft.Json12.0.3; API provides CVE/GHSA, version options and reachable source locations.

records.description: Newtonsoft.Json before version 13.0.1 is affected by a mishandling of exceptional conditions vulnerability. Crafted data that is passed to the JsonConvert.DeserializeObject method may trigger a StackOverflow exception resulting in denial of service. Depending on the usage of the library, an unauthenticated and remote attacker may be able to cause the denial of service condition.
limitations: Reachability locations are analyzer evidence, not a runtime exploit or proof of deployed package identity.
Version recommendations/EPSS are captured API metadata and not a completed upgrade, compatibility test or current live recommendation.
SCA status updatedAt differs from the core code-analysis date; no analyzed SCM commit was supplied.
